text:
maria: Hey folks — opened a PR that implements workload-aware routing for cheaper model variants. This is gated on the architecture review per the RFC linked below. Please take a quick look when you have a moment. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8573 RFC: https://docs.redwood.ai/rfcs/2026-routing.md TL;DR: route non-sensitive short prompts to opt-quant model by default, fallback to base model on mismatch. Need confirmation on cache invalidation semantics and rollout/monitoring plan.

jonathan: Thanks for the ping — skimmed the RFC. Big picture looks fine. Quick q: does this change the cache key/namespace? that would be a migration risk.

maria: Good question. No key/namespace change — we add a routing-tag header and a variant flag in the response. Code snippet added to PR: 
```json
{
  "routing": {
    "preference": "cost-first",
    "variant_header": "x-rw-variant"
  }
}
```
This avoids touching prefix/KV keys.

sara: Pinging @kevin for perf/observability concerns. If the variant header affects cache lookup ordering we need to ensure trace continuity.

kevin: Looking. Two initial asks: 1) add a perf run (p50/p95 + tokens/sec) for both paths (variant vs base) 2) canary plan: 5% for 12h -> 25% for 24h -> 100% if metrics stable. Watch gen latency, error rate, and cache hit ratio.

maria: Will add perf numbers and the canary timeline to the PR description. Is the arch ack required before I add the canary config to the deploy pipeline? I left the PR marked as "merge-gated-by-rfc".

jonathan: Arch ack first, yes. I can do a quick design pass but want @sara to confirm no compatibility holes in tracing/logging.

sara: Confirming: as long as the variant header is orthogonal to cache keys, traces look fine. We should add a small e2e smoke that asserts header propagation through the runtime and to tracing.

arch-bot: Reminder: please add the `arch-stamp` label after receiving approver + a short summary comment referencing the RFC ID (rfc-2026).

kevin: Also: include a rollback playbook snippet in the PR (how to flip routing off quickly). Simple feature-flag toggle should suffice.

maria: Will add rollback steps and an e2e smoke. Plan: I'll run perf tests this afternoon, add canary + rollback, and tag for arch review. If we get +1 from arch (jonathan/sara) and perf numbers look good, can merge and start canary.

jonathan: I can give the +1 after seeing perf numbers and the e2e smoke.

sara: +1 pending perf numbers.

maria: Thanks everyone :pray: I'll update the PR today and ping back here when it's ready for final check.
